decision: A full-screen vertical feed that snaps one reel at a time, with a progress bar and double-tap to like, the pattern popularized by short-video apps
why: Creators already produce this format; the shopping layer is what Maré adds.
alternative: A grid of creator videos that opens a player.

decision: Only the reel in view animates (IntersectionObserver), and each 'video' is a CSS loop over the product silhouette
why: Offscreen playback wastes battery and main-thread time; real video would cost megabytes per reel.
value: The feed stays smooth on low-end phones with no media download.

decision: A floating tag names the hero product in the reel, and 'Shop 3 items in this reel' opens a sheet with every item and Add all
why: Viewers want the look, not one piece; the tag answers 'what is that?' without covering the creator.
value: From reel to bag in two taps.

decision: Adding from a reel stamps the order with the creator's reel id, so Circle attributes the commission without a code
why: Codes leak and get forgotten; the reel is the referral.
alternative: Ask viewers to type the creator's code at checkout.
value: Fair attribution and fewer leaked codes (MARI15).

decision: Double-tap and the heart button do the same thing, and Pause stops the progress and motion
why: Gestures are invisible to screen readers and keyboards; anything moving needs a pause (WCAG 2.2.2).
alternative: Gesture-only likes and autoplay without controls.
value: The playful gesture stays, and nobody is locked out.
